Class HourDiff

java.lang.Object
echoshift.nightscripts.HourDiff
public class HourDiff extends Object
Difficulty getter and setter for the game Echo Shift. To initialize difficulty using a given hour and day, use constructor HourDiff(hour, night). To set a new difficulty, use setter setHourDiff(hour,night). To get the difficulty, use getter getDifficulty(hour, night).
